versioning.scheme: Date-based API versions with a release name suffix (e.g. 2026-10-28.endive), pinned per request with the Stripe-Version header or by the server-side SDK release. Since 2024-09-30.acacia: additive monthly versions, plus two major releases a year whose first version carries breaking changes. Separate .preview versions for the public preview channel.

source.quote: Starting with the 2024-09-30.acacia release, Stripe follows a [new API release process](https://stripe.com/blog/introducing-stripes-new-api-release-process) where we release new API versions monthly with no breaking changes.
The current version is 2026-10-28.endive.
The current preview API version is **2026-10-28.preview**.
